sections.chapter_title: General-purpose and alternate-function I/Os (GPIOs and AFIOs)
sections.text_helper: Section 9.2.4 "Port output data register (GPIOx_ODR) (x=A..G)" in chapter 9 (General-purpose and alternate-function I/Os (GPIOs and AFIOs)), RM0008 Rev 21, page 173.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Reserved
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 ODRy: Port output data (y= 0 .. 15)
These bits can be read and written by software and can be accessed in Word mode only.
Note: For atomic bit set/reset, the ODR bits can be individually set and cleared by writing to
the GPIOx_BSRR register (x = A .. G).
